name: [NEW] Grass Farming Simulator
desc:
🌱 Welcome to Grass Farming Simulator! 🌿
⚡OFFLINE REWARD⚡
💎 Roblox Premium? You get even more money and grass!
Ready to become the ultimate grass farmer? 🌾
👉 Harvest grass like a pro and stack up that gold! 💰
🐶 Get cute pets that’ll help you farm faster and better!
⚡ Power up with boosts like Speed and x2 Luck — speed through the fields!
🎁 Unlock epic stuff like V.I.P Chests and Infinite Grass Space!
🥚 Hatch rare eggs and collect the coolest pets around!
🌍 Explore new zones with the Teleporter and find hidden surprises!
🎩 Snag limited-time items like the legendary Sky Sweeper — don’t miss out!


Jump in, farm hard, and have a blast! Let’s grow that grass empire! 🌱🔥
